name: balance-slider
title: Balance Slider
description: A horizontal control that splits a hundred percent between a left side and a right side. Dragging shifts the two coloured fills and a thin divider while both end percentages update live.
use: One value should read as a trade-off between two named sides, such as warmth or audio panning.
avoid: Its size is pinned at 320 by 120 pixels, so it will not stretch to a wide container.
a11y: Arrow keys drive the native range input, but the see-through input has no name and the visible LEFT and RIGHT text is aria-hidden. (keyboard: yes, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Inside a dark rounded card, a wide bar is cut into a dim left fill and a pale right fill with a slim white divider between them. A percentage label sits at each end, and the bar's hue follows the chosen side colours.
behaves: Dragging anywhere on the bar moves the divider and resizes both fills as the two percentages count up and down. Hovering or focusing lifts the label row and brightens the indicator, easing back on leave.
customise: initialValue, both side colours, both labels, the shift limits, indicator colour and corner radius are props; the 320 by 120 frame is fixed in the source.
weight: light: A single native range input driving CSS transitions on two fills and a label row.
